vo_open.text: He kept waiting for almost ten years.

vo.text: Every day, Hachikō met Professor Ueno at Shibuya Station in Tokyo.
vo.cap: Every day, *Hachikō* met Professor Ueno at *Shibuya Station.*

vo.text: In May 1925, Ueno died suddenly. He never came back.
vo.cap: *May 1925:* Ueno died suddenly. He *never came back.*

vo.text: Hachikō kept returning to the station, almost every day, for nine years and nine months.
vo.cap: He kept coming back. For *9 years and 9 months.*

vo.text: In 1934, they built him a statue at the station. He was still alive.
vo.cap: *1934:* a statue at the station. He was *still alive.*
